title: Space Organisations
definition: Comprehensive institutional architectures, governance bodies, and international agencies dedicated to space exploration, research, policy formulation, and commercial exploitation.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science & Technology (GS Paper III: Awareness in Space Technology) and International Relations (global space governance, treaties, and geo-politics).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Space Organisations.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Indian Space Programme history
Overview of ISRO and Department of Space
